# ETA Price

> Official fees of the electronic travel authorisations (UK ETA, US ESTA, Canada eTA, Australia ETA and eVisitor, New Zealand NZeTA, EU ETIAS), applied to the traveller's passport and group, converted to euros at the ECB reference rate. Published by Radif Partners. Not a government site, not a visa agency: it files no application and sends the reader to the official site only.

Data: fees, nationality lists and validity read from GOV.UK (Home Office fee tables), the US Federal Register and 8 CFR 217, canada.ca and the Immigration and Refugee Protection Regulations, the Australian Department of Home Affairs, Immigration New Zealand and the European Commission; ECB euro reference rates. Each page shows the date the data was read. Updated by a script every working day.
